## Load data

```{python}
from IPython.display import HTML, display
import html
import math
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd().parent / "database_module"))

from db_handler import DbHandler, DbUtils
from db_config import USERNAME, PASSWORD, DATABASE_NAME, HOST, PORT, PGS_EXCEL_FILEPATH

db_handler = DbHandler(port=PORT, db_url=None, user=USERNAME, password=PASSWORD, host=HOST)
db_handler.connect()
db_utils = DbUtils(db_handler)

prsc_id = 2667  # placeholder for testing jobs, 2842 psychi, 2685 cardiovascular, 2821 opth, 2820 other, 2918 blood panel, 2667 cancer
#issue with 2667 bottom card, oddsratio % increase calculated wrong

ethnicity_query = f"""
SELECT *
FROM snpster_users.user_ancestry
WHERE user_id = (
    SELECT user_id
    FROM snpster_users.imputation_jobs
    WHERE imputation_id IN (
        SELECT imputation_id
        FROM snpster_users.prsc_jobs
        WHERE prsc_id = {prsc_id}
        LIMIT 1
    )
)
"""

""" CREATE TABLE snpster_users.user_ancestry (
    user_id VARCHAR(100) PRIMARY KEY
        REFERENCES snpster_users.user_information(user_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    eur NUMERIC(8,6) CHECK (eur >= 0 AND eur <= 1),
    afr NUMERIC(8,6) CHECK (afr >= 0 AND afr <= 1),
    eas NUMERIC(8,6) CHECK (eas >= 0 AND eas <= 1),
    sas NUMERIC(8,6) CHECK (sas >= 0 AND sas <= 1),
    amr NUMERIC(8,6) CHECK (amr >= 0 AND amr <= 1),

    primary_ancestry VARCHAR(10)
        CHECK (primary_ancestry IN ('EUR', 'AFR', 'EAS', 'SAS', 'AMR')),

    primary_ancestry_percentage NUMERIC(8,6)
        CHECK (primary_ancestry_percentage >= 0 AND primary_ancestry_percentage <= 1),

    ancestry_method VARCHAR(100),
    reference_panel VARCHAR(100),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
"""


query = f""" 
SELECT
    pjr.pgs_id,

    CASE
        WHEN pcd.reported_trait IN ('Coronary artery disease', 'Coronary Artery Disease')
            THEN 'Coronary heart disease'
        ELSE pcd.reported_trait
    END AS reported_trait,

    pp.reported_trait AS specific_trait,
    pcd.ancestry_distribution_pgs_evaluation,
    pjr.percentile_most_similar_pop,
    pjr.z_most_similar_pop,
    pjr.z_norm1,
    pjr.z_norm2,
    pjr.percent_variants_matched,
    pjr.n_variants_matched,
    pp.ppm_id,
    pp.pss_id,
    pp.pgp_id,
    ess.individuals_evaluation,
    ess.cases_evaluation,
    ess.controls_evaluation,
    ess.percent_male_evaluation,
    pp.pgs_performance_other_relevant_info,
    pp.publication_pmid,
    pp.publication_doi,
    pp.hazard_ratio,
    pp.odds_ratio,
    pp.beta,
    pp.auroc,
    pp.concordance_statistic,
    pub.first_author,
    pub.title,
    pub.journal_name,
    pub.publication_date,
    pub.release_date AS publication_release_date,
    pub.authors,
    pub.pubmed_id_pmid,
    pcd.number_of_variants,
    pcd.original_genome_build,
    pcd.type_of_variant_weight,
    pcd.pgs_development_method,
    pcd.release_date AS pgs_release_date

FROM snpster_users.prsc_job_results AS pjr

LEFT JOIN data_libraries.pgs_performance AS pp
    ON pp.pgs_id = pjr.pgs_id

LEFT JOIN data_libraries.pgs_publications AS pub
    ON pub.pgp_id = pp.pgp_id

LEFT JOIN data_libraries.pgscatalog_data AS pcd
    ON pcd.pgs_id = pjr.pgs_id

LEFT JOIN data_libraries.evaluation_sample_sets AS ess
    ON ess.pss_id = pp.pss_id

WHERE pjr.prsc_id = {prsc_id}
  AND pp.auroc IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY reported_trait, pp.auroc DESC;
"""

data = db_utils.get_pd_dataframe_from_query(query)
data = data.drop_duplicates()

ancestry_df = db_utils.get_pd_dataframe_from_query(ethnicity_query)  # use full dataframe in future to more gracefully weigh scoring files
primary_ancestry_code = ancestry_df["primary_ancestry"].iloc[0]  # EUR, AMR, AFR, EAS, SAS

ancestry_label_map = {
    "EUR": "European",
    "AFR": "African",
    "EAS": "East Asian",
    "SAS": "South Asian",
    "AMR": "Admixed American",
}

ethnicity = ancestry_label_map.get(primary_ancestry_code, primary_ancestry_code)
MIN_PRIMARY_VARIANT_MATCH_PCT = 70.0

```

## Prepare data

```{python}
def parse_superpopulation_dict(entry):
    """
    Converts:
        "African:33.3|East Asian:33.3|South Asian:33.3"
    into:
        {"African": 33.3, "East Asian": 33.3, "South Asian": 33.3}
    """
    if entry is None or pd.isna(entry):
        return {}

    result = {}

    for part in str(entry).split("|"):
        part = part.strip()

        if not part or ":" not in part:
            continue

        superpop, value = part.split(":", 1)

        try:
            value = float(value.strip())
        except ValueError:
            value = None

        result[superpop.strip()] = value

    return result


def risk_level(percentile):
    """Five-category percentile classification based on the selected best model.

    Thresholds can be tuned later, but these are simple launch defaults:
      <5   = Very low
      5-19 = Lowered
      20-79 = Normal
      80-94 = Increased
      >=95 = Highly Increased
    """
    if pd.isna(percentile):
        return ("Unknown", "normal", "fill-normal")

    percentile = float(percentile)

    if percentile >= 95:
        return ("Highly Increased", "highly-increased", "fill-highly-increased")
    if percentile >= 80:
        return ("Increased", "increased", "fill-increased")
    if percentile >= 20:
        return ("Normal", "normal", "fill-normal")
    if percentile >= 5:
        return ("Lowered", "lowered", "fill-lowered")
    return ("Very low", "very-low", "fill-very-low")


def ordinal_suffix(n):
    n = int(n)
    if 10 <= (n % 100) <= 20:
        return "th"
    return {1: "st", 2: "nd", 3: "rd"}.get(n % 10, "th")


def fmt_percentile(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return "Not available"
    n = int(round(float(x)))
    return f"{n}{ordinal_suffix(n)}"


def fmt_percentile_range(low, high):
    if pd.isna(low) or pd.isna(high):
        return None

    low_i = int(round(float(low)))
    high_i = int(round(float(high)))

    if low_i == high_i:
        return fmt_percentile(low_i)

    return f"{fmt_percentile(low_i)}–{fmt_percentile(high_i)}"


def clamp_percentile(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return 0.0
    return max(0.0, min(100.0, float(x)))


def fmt_float(x, digits=2):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return None
    return f"{float(x):.{digits}f}"


def fmt_int(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return None
    return f"{int(float(x)):,}"


def variant_match_percent_value(x):
    """Return variant match as a 0-100 percentage for filtering/ranking."""
    if pd.isna(x):
        return np.nan

    x = float(x)
    if x <= 1:
        x = x * 100
    return x


def fmt_variant_match_pct(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return None

    x = variant_match_percent_value(x)
    return f"{x:.1f}%"


def fmt_variant_match_summary(row):
    if row is None:
        return None

    pct = fmt_variant_match_pct(row.get("percent_variants_matched", np.nan))
    n = fmt_int(row.get("n_variants_matched", np.nan))

    if pct and n:
        return f"{pct} ({n} variants)"
    if pct:
        return pct
    if n:
        return f"{n} variants"
    return None


def fmt_date(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return None
    return str(pd.to_datetime(x).date())


def safe_text(x, fallback="Not available"):
    if x is None or pd.isna(x) or str(x).strip() == "":
        return fallback
    return html.escape(str(x))


def shorten(text, n=170):
    if text is None or pd.isna(text):
        return None
    text = str(text).strip()
    if len(text) <= n:
        return text
    return text[: n - 1].rstrip() + "…"


def get_eval_n(row):
    if not pd.isna(row.get("individuals_evaluation", np.nan)):
        return float(row["individuals_evaluation"])

    cases = 0 if pd.isna(row.get("cases_evaluation", np.nan)) else float(row["cases_evaluation"])
    controls = 0 if pd.isna(row.get("controls_evaluation", np.nan)) else float(row["controls_evaluation"])
    total = cases + controls
    return total if total > 0 else np.nan


def add_ranking_columns(df, ethnicity):
    df = df.copy()

    df["ancestry_distribution_dict"] = df["ancestry_distribution_pgs_evaluation"].apply(parse_superpopulation_dict)
    df["target_ethnicity_share"] = df["ancestry_distribution_dict"].apply(lambda d: d.get(ethnicity))
    df["evaluation_n"] = df.apply(get_eval_n, axis=1)

    df["auroc"] = pd.to_numeric(df["auroc"], errors="coerce")
    df["percentile_most_similar_pop"] = pd.to_numeric(df["percentile_most_similar_pop"], errors="coerce")
    df["z_most_similar_pop"] = pd.to_numeric(df["z_most_similar_pop"], errors="coerce")
    df["odds_ratio"] = pd.to_numeric(df["odds_ratio"], errors="coerce")
    df["hazard_ratio"] = pd.to_numeric(df["hazard_ratio"], errors="coerce")
    df["evaluation_n"] = pd.to_numeric(df["evaluation_n"], errors="coerce")
    df["percent_variants_matched"] = pd.to_numeric(df["percent_variants_matched"], errors="coerce")
    df["n_variants_matched"] = pd.to_numeric(df["n_variants_matched"], errors="coerce")
    df["variant_match_pct_for_ranking"] = df["percent_variants_matched"].apply(variant_match_percent_value)
    df["primary_model_eligible"] = df["variant_match_pct_for_ranking"].ge(MIN_PRIMARY_VARIANT_MATCH_PCT)

    # User-specific percent change, not the raw OR/HR per SD.
    # This assumes OR/HR are reported per 1 SD increase in PRS.
    df["individual_odds_ratio"] = np.where(
        df["odds_ratio"].notna() & df["z_most_similar_pop"].notna(),
        ((df["odds_ratio"] ** df["z_most_similar_pop"]) - 1) * 100,
        np.nan,
    )

    df["individual_hazard_ratio"] = np.where(
        df["hazard_ratio"].notna() & df["z_most_similar_pop"].notna(),
        ((df["hazard_ratio"] ** df["z_most_similar_pop"]) - 1) * 100,
        np.nan,
    )

    return df.drop(columns=["ancestry_distribution_dict"])


def filter_to_target_ethnicity(df, ethnicity):
    """Remove validation rows without any target ancestry after the query."""
    before = len(df)
    df = df[df["target_ethnicity_share"].notna() & (df["target_ethnicity_share"] > 0)].copy()
    after = len(df)
    print(f"Dropped {before - after} performance rows with no positive {ethnicity} evaluation share.")
    return df


def sort_for_best_model(df):
    return df.sort_values(
        by=["auroc", "target_ethnicity_share", "evaluation_n"],
        ascending=[False, False, False],
        na_position="last",
    )


def eligible_for_primary(df):
    """Only models with enough variant overlap can become the displayed primary/top model."""
    return df[df["primary_model_eligible"].fillna(False)].copy()


def best_row(df, require_primary_eligible=False):
    if df.empty:
        return None

    if require_primary_eligible:
        df = eligible_for_primary(df)
        if df.empty:
            return None

    return sort_for_best_model(df).iloc[0]


def best_rows_per_pgs(df):
    """Keep every PGS ID, but collapse duplicate validation rows for the same PGS to its best row."""
    rows = []
    for _, pgs_df in df.groupby("pgs_id", sort=False):
        row = best_row(pgs_df)
        if row is not None:
            rows.append(row)
    if not rows:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=df.columns)
    return pd.DataFrame(rows).reset_index(drop=True)


def pick_metric_row(trait_models, metric_col):
    """Pick the best-ranked eligible PGS model that can support a metric."""
    metric_df = trait_models[trait_models[metric_col].notna()].copy()
    return best_row(metric_df, require_primary_eligible=True)


def percent_change_text(x):
    """Display individualized percent change derived from OR/HR and user z-score."""
    if pd.isna(x):
        return "NA"

    x = float(x)
    if abs(x) < 0.05:
        return "No material change"

    direction = "higher" if x > 0 else "lower"
    return f"{abs(x):.1f}% {direction}"


def effect_per_sd_text(row, raw_col, label):
    """Display the published per-SD OR/HR as a caption under the individualized % value."""
    if row is None:
        return f"{label} per SD NA"

    raw = row.get(raw_col, np.nan)
    if pd.isna(raw):
        return f"{label} per SD NA"

    return f"{label} per SD {float(raw):.2f}"


def effect_source_caption(row, raw_col, label):
    """Caption shown under the odds/hazard percent-change metric box."""
    return effect_per_sd_text(row, raw_col, label)


data = add_ranking_columns(data, ethnicity)
data = filter_to_target_ethnicity(data, ethnicity)
data = data.drop_duplicates()

# One display card per reported_trait.
# Every PGS model with target-ancestry validation is kept for the dropdown.
# Primary model ranking:
#   0. model must have at least MIN_PRIMARY_VARIANT_MATCH_PCT variants matched
#   1. highest AUROC
#   2. highest evaluation ancestry match for the user
#   3. largest evaluation sample size
# OR/HR metric rows are selected separately using the same ranking, because a single PGS
# may not have both OR and HR available.
# Models below the variant-match threshold are still shown in the expandable table,
# but they cannot become the primary/top model.
card_records = []
for trait, trait_df in data.groupby("reported_trait", sort=True):
    trait_models = best_rows_per_pgs(trait_df)
    trait_models = sort_for_best_model(trait_models)

    primary = best_row(trait_models, require_primary_eligible=True)
    odds_source = pick_metric_row(trait_models, "individual_odds_ratio")
    hazard_source = pick_metric_row(trait_models, "individual_hazard_ratio")

    if primary is None:
        continue

    card_records.append({
        "reported_trait": trait,
        "primary": primary,
        "odds_source": odds_source,
        "hazard_source": hazard_source,
        "all_models": trait_models,
    })

cards_df = pd.DataFrame([
    {
        "reported_trait": record["reported_trait"],
        "primary_pgs_id": record["primary"]["pgs_id"],
        "primary_auroc": record["primary"]["auroc"],
        "primary_percentile": record["primary"]["percentile_most_similar_pop"],
        "primary_evaluation_n": record["primary"]["evaluation_n"],
        "primary_ethnicity_share": record["primary"]["target_ethnicity_share"],
        "primary_percent_variants_matched": record["primary"].get("percent_variants_matched", np.nan),
        "primary_n_variants_matched": record["primary"].get("n_variants_matched", np.nan),
        "primary_variant_match_pct_for_ranking": record["primary"].get("variant_match_pct_for_ranking", np.nan),
        "n_models": len(record["all_models"]),
        "has_odds": record["odds_source"] is not None,
        "has_hazard": record["hazard_source"] is not None,
    }
    for record in card_records
]).sort_values(["reported_trait"])
```

mean_percentile = cards_df["primary_percentile"].mean() if not cards_df.empty else np.nan
mean_auroc = cards_df["primary_auroc"].mean() if not cards_df.empty else np.nan

```{=html}
<div class="method-note">
  <strong>Model selection.</strong>
  The report first removes validation rows that do not contain a positive share of the user's target ancestry. A model must also have at least 70% matched variants to become the primary/top model. Each trait card then selects the primary eligible model by: highest AUROC, then highest target-ancestry share in the evaluation sample, then largest evaluation sample size. Additional retained models for the same trait are kept and shown in the expandable model-details section, including models below the primary-model variant-match threshold. Risk categories are based on the selected best model percentile for traits with fewer than 4 retained scores, and on the median retained-model percentile when more than 4 scores are available. For traits with more than 4 retained scores, the main percentile bar shows the observed retained-model percentile range, mean, and translucent IQR band. The 95% CONFIDENCE INTERVAL is shown only as a separate sub-card.
</div>

If no odds or hazard effect is available for a trait, the card displays <code>NA</code>.

## Polygenic score cards

```{python}
def make_metric_box(label, value, caption=None):
    if value is None:
        return ""

    caption_html = f'<div class="metric-caption">{html.escape(caption)}</div>' if caption else ""

    return f"""
    <div class="metric-box">
      <div class="metric-label">{html.escape(label)}</div>
      <div class="metric-value">{html.escape(value)}</div>
      {caption_html}
    </div>
    """


def make_meta_row(key, value):
    if value is None or pd.isna(value) or str(value).strip() == "":
        return ""

    return f"""
    <div class="meta-row">
      <div class="meta-key">{html.escape(str(key))}</div>
      <div class="meta-value">{html.escape(str(value))}</div>
    </div>
    """


def publication_summary(row):
    if row is None:
        return None

    pmid = row.get("pubmed_id_pmid", np.nan)

    if pd.isna(pmid):
        return None

    return f"PMID: {int(float(pmid))}"

def add_source_metadata(meta_rows, prefix, row):
    if row is None:
        return meta_rows

    meta_rows += make_meta_row(f"{prefix} PGS", row.get("pgs_id", np.nan))
    meta_rows += make_meta_row(f"{prefix} AUROC", fmt_float(row.get("auroc", np.nan), 2))
    meta_rows += make_meta_row(f"{prefix} variants matched", fmt_variant_match_summary(row))
    meta_rows += make_meta_row(f"{prefix} variant match %", fmt_variant_match_pct(row.get("percent_variants_matched", np.nan)))
    meta_rows += make_meta_row(f"{prefix} n variants matched", fmt_int(row.get("n_variants_matched", np.nan)))
    meta_rows += make_meta_row(f"{prefix} ethnicity share", f"{float(row['target_ethnicity_share']):.1f}%" if not pd.isna(row.get("target_ethnicity_share", np.nan)) else None)
    meta_rows += make_meta_row(f"{prefix} eval. N", fmt_int(row.get("evaluation_n", np.nan)))
    meta_rows += make_meta_row(f"{prefix} cases", fmt_int(row.get("cases_evaluation", np.nan)))
    meta_rows += make_meta_row(f"{prefix} controls", fmt_int(row.get("controls_evaluation", np.nan)))
    meta_rows += make_meta_row(f"{prefix} ancestry", row.get("ancestry_distribution_pgs_evaluation", np.nan))
    meta_rows += make_meta_row(f"{prefix} literature", publication_summary(row))
    meta_rows += make_meta_row(f"{prefix} DOI", row.get("publication_doi", np.nan))
    meta_rows += make_meta_row(f"{prefix} PMID", row.get("publication_pmid", np.nan))
    return meta_rows


def model_table_value(value):
    if value is None or pd.isna(value):
        return ""
    return html.escape(str(value))


def make_model_rows(models_df):
    rows = []
    for _, row in models_df.iterrows():
        odds = effect_per_sd_text(row, "odds_ratio", "OR")
        hazard = effect_per_sd_text(row, "hazard_ratio", "HR")
        pub = publication_summary(row)

        rows.append(f"""
        <tr>
          <td>{model_table_value(row.get('pgs_id', np.nan))}</td>
          <td>{model_table_value(fmt_percentile(row.get('percentile_most_similar_pop', np.nan)))}</td>
          <td>{model_table_value(fmt_float(row.get('auroc', np.nan), 2))}</td>
          <td>{model_table_value(odds)}</td>
          <td>{model_table_value(hazard)}</td>
          <td>{model_table_value(fmt_variant_match_pct(row.get('percent_variants_matched', np.nan)))}</td>
          <td>{model_table_value(fmt_int(row.get('n_variants_matched', np.nan)))}</td>
          <td>{model_table_value(f"{float(row['target_ethnicity_share']):.1f}%" if not pd.isna(row.get('target_ethnicity_share', np.nan)) else None)}</td>
          <td>{model_table_value(fmt_int(row.get('evaluation_n', np.nan)))}</td>
          <td>{model_table_value(fmt_int(row.get('cases_evaluation', np.nan)))}</td>
          <td>{model_table_value(fmt_int(row.get('controls_evaluation', np.nan)))}</td>
          <td>{model_table_value(pub)}</td>
        </tr>
        """)
    return "\n".join(rows)


def make_models_dropdown(models_df):
    if models_df is None or models_df.empty:
        return ""

    rows = make_model_rows(models_df)
    return f"""
    <details style="max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden;">
      <summary>Show all retained PGS models for this trait ({len(models_df)})</summary>
      <div class="model-table-scroll-hint">Scroll horizontally to view all model metadata.</div>
      <div class="model-table-wrap" aria-label="Scrollable retained PGS model table" style="max-width: 100%; width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: hidden;">
        <table class="model-table" style="width: 1180px; min-width: 1180px; max-width: none; table-layout: fixed;">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>PGS ID</th>
              <th>Percentile</th>
              <th>AUROC</th>
              <th>OR per SD</th>
              <th>HR per SD</th>
              <th>Variant match %</th>
              <th>Variants matched</th>
              <th>{html.escape(ethnicity)} share</th>
              <th>Eval. N</th>
              <th>Cases</th>
              <th>Controls</th>
              <th>Literature</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {rows}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </details>
    """


def percentile_values(models_df):
    if models_df is None or models_df.empty:
        return pd.Series(dtype=float)
    return pd.to_numeric(models_df["percentile_most_similar_pop"], errors="coerce").dropna()


def percentile_distribution_stats(models_df):
    if models_df is None or models_df.empty:
        return None

    df = models_df.copy()
    df["percentile_numeric"] = pd.to_numeric(df["percentile_most_similar_pop"], errors="coerce")
    df = df[df["percentile_numeric"].notna()].copy()

    if df.empty:
        return None

    values = df["percentile_numeric"].astype(float).to_numpy()
    values_series = pd.Series(values)
    mean = float(values_series.mean())

    if len(values) > 1:
        sd = float(values_series.std())
        se = sd / math.sqrt(len(values))
        ci_low = clamp_percentile(mean - 1.96 * se)
        ci_high = clamp_percentile(mean + 1.96 * se)
    else:
        sd = 0.0
        se = 0.0
        ci_low = clamp_percentile(mean)
        ci_high = clamp_percentile(mean)

    return {
        "n": len(values),
        "mean": mean,
        "sd": sd,
        "se": se,
        "q1": float(values_series.quantile(0.25)),
        "median": float(values_series.median()),
        "q3": float(values_series.quantile(0.75)),
        "min": float(values_series.min()),
        "max": float(values_series.max()),
        "ci_low": float(ci_low),
        "ci_high": float(ci_high),
    }


def use_distribution_percentile_view(models_df):
    """Use IQR/median display for traits with more than 4 retained scores."""
    return len(percentile_values(models_df)) > 4


def make_percentile_distribution_view(models_df, fill_class):
    """Use the compact distribution style for traits with >4 retained scores.

    The main bar shows the observed retained-model percentile range as a slim
    colored segment on a gray 0-100 scale. The translucent overlay shows the IQR,
    and the black marker shows the median percentile. The 95% CONFIDENCE INTERVAL
    is intentionally kept as text in the metric sub-card, not drawn on the bar.
    """
    stats = percentile_distribution_stats(models_df)
    if stats is None:
        return ""

    q1 = clamp_percentile(stats["q1"])
    q3 = clamp_percentile(stats["q3"])
    median = clamp_percentile(stats["median"])
    min_pct = clamp_percentile(stats["min"])
    max_pct = clamp_percentile(stats["max"])

    iqr_left = q1
    iqr_width = max(0.0, q3 - q1)
    whisker_left = min_pct
    whisker_width = max(0.0, max_pct - min_pct)

    return f"""
    <div class="percentile-distribution" aria-label="Percentile distribution across retained PGS models">
      <div class="percentile-distribution-track">
        <div class="percentile-distribution-axis" title="Full percentile scale"></div>
        <div class="percentile-distribution-whisker {fill_class}" title="Observed retained-model percentile range: {fmt_percentile(min_pct)}–{fmt_percentile(max_pct)}" style="left: {whisker_left:.1f}%; width: {whisker_width:.1f}%;"></div>
        <div class="percentile-distribution-iqr" title="Interquartile range: {fmt_percentile(q1)}–{fmt_percentile(q3)}" style="left: {iqr_left:.1f}%; width: {iqr_width:.1f}%;"></div>
        <div class="percentile-distribution-mean" title="Median retained-model percentile: {fmt_percentile(median)}" style="left: {median:.1f}%;"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="percentile-distribution-legend" aria-label="Percentile distribution legend">
        <span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-mean-key"></span>Median percentile</span>
        <span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-iqr-key"></span>IQR</span>
        <span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-swatch {fill_class}"></span>Observed range</span>
      </div>
      <div class="percentile-distribution-caption">Median {fmt_percentile(stats['median'])}; IQR {fmt_percentile(stats['q1'])}–{fmt_percentile(stats['q3'])}; observed range {fmt_percentile(stats['min'])}–{fmt_percentile(stats['max'])}; SD {stats['sd']:.1f} percentile points across {stats['n']} retained models.</div>
    </div>
    """

def make_consensus_box(models_df, primary_percentile):
    values = percentile_values(models_df)

    # For traits with many retained models, the main visualization already shows
    # mean, IQR, and SD. Do not show the older consensus/disagreement panel.
    if use_distribution_percentile_view(models_df):
        return ""

    if len(values) <= 1:
        return ""

    low = values.min()
    high = values.max()
    range_text = fmt_percentile_range(low, high)

    return f"""
    <div class="consensus-box">
      <div class="metric-label">Multi-model consensus</div>
      <div class="consensus-value">{html.escape(range_text)}</div>
      <div class="metric-caption">Range across {len(values)} retained PGS models. Consensus area = solid bar; model disagreement range = translucent band.</div>
    </div>
    """


def make_percentile_bar(primary_percentile, models_df, fill_class):
    if use_distribution_percentile_view(models_df):
        return make_percentile_distribution_view(models_df, fill_class)

    primary_pct = clamp_percentile(primary_percentile)
    values = percentile_values(models_df)

    if values.empty:
        low = primary_pct
        high = primary_pct
    else:
        low = clamp_percentile(values.min())
        high = clamp_percentile(values.max())

    # The solid segment shows the percentile range all retained models agree is reached.
    # The translucent segment shows the spread between the lowest and highest model estimates.
    solid_width = low if len(values) > 1 else primary_pct
    band_left = low
    band_width = max(0.0, high - low)

    uncertainty_html = ""
    disagreement_legend = ""
    if len(values) > 1 and band_width > 0:
        uncertainty_html = f'<div class="percentile-uncertainty {fill_class}" title="Model disagreement range" style="left: {band_left:.1f}%; width: {band_width:.1f}%"></div>'
        disagreement_legend = f'<span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-swatch translucent {fill_class}"></span>Model disagreement range</span>'

    consensus_label = "Consensus area" if len(values) > 1 else "Predicted percentile range"

    return f"""
    <div class="percentile-track" aria-label="Percentile bar">
      <div class="percentile-solid {fill_class}" title="{consensus_label}" style="width: {solid_width:.1f}%"></div>
      {uncertainty_html}
      <div class="percentile-marker" title="Best Model Prediction: {fmt_percentile(primary_pct)}" style="left: {primary_pct:.1f}%"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="percentile-legend" aria-label="Percentile bar legend">
      <span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-marker-key"></span>Best Model Prediction</span>
      <span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-swatch {fill_class}"></span>{consensus_label}</span>
      {disagreement_legend}
    </div>
    """



def mean_numeric(models_df, col):
    if models_df is None or models_df.empty or col not in models_df.columns:
        return np.nan
    return pd.to_numeric(models_df[col], errors="coerce").mean()


def mean_variant_match_pct(models_df):
    if models_df is None or models_df.empty or "percent_variants_matched" not in models_df.columns:
        return np.nan
    values = pd.to_numeric(models_df["percent_variants_matched"], errors="coerce").apply(variant_match_percent_value)
    return values.mean()

def make_trait_card(record):
    primary = record["primary"]
    odds_source = record["odds_source"]
    hazard_source = record["hazard_source"]
    all_models = record["all_models"]

    percentile = primary["percentile_most_similar_pop"]
    distribution_stats = percentile_distribution_stats(all_models)
    show_distribution_view = use_distribution_percentile_view(all_models)
    display_percentile = distribution_stats["median"] if show_distribution_view and distribution_stats is not None else percentile

    risk_label, risk_class, fill_class = risk_level(display_percentile)
    percentile_bar = make_percentile_bar(percentile, all_models, fill_class)
    consensus_box = make_consensus_box(all_models, percentile)

    trait = safe_text(primary["reported_trait"])
    pgs_id = safe_text(primary["pgs_id"])
    subtitle = f"Selected primary model: {pgs_id}"

    odds_value = percent_change_text(odds_source["individual_odds_ratio"]) if odds_source is not None else "NA"
    odds_caption = effect_source_caption(odds_source, "odds_ratio", "OR")

    hazard_value = percent_change_text(hazard_source["individual_hazard_ratio"]) if hazard_source is not None else "NA"
    hazard_caption = effect_source_caption(hazard_source, "hazard_ratio", "HR")

    if show_distribution_view:
        auroc_value = fmt_float(mean_numeric(all_models, "auroc"), 2)
        auroc_caption = f"Mean across {len(all_models)} retained models"
        variant_match_value = fmt_variant_match_pct(mean_variant_match_pct(all_models))
        variant_match_caption = f"Mean across {len(all_models)} retained models"
    else:
        auroc_value = fmt_float(primary["auroc"], 2)
        auroc_caption = "Primary model validation"
        variant_match_value = fmt_variant_match_pct(primary.get("percent_variants_matched", np.nan))
        variant_match_caption = (
            f"{fmt_int(primary.get('n_variants_matched', np.nan))} variants matched in primary model"
            if fmt_int(primary.get("n_variants_matched", np.nan))
            else "Primary model"
        )

    metric_boxes = ""
    metric_boxes += make_metric_box("AUROC", auroc_value, auroc_caption)
    metric_boxes += make_metric_box("Odds-based risk", odds_value, odds_caption)
    metric_boxes += make_metric_box("Hazard-based risk", hazard_value, hazard_caption)

    if show_distribution_view and distribution_stats is not None:
        metric_boxes += make_metric_box(
            "95% CONFIDENCE INTERVAL",
            fmt_percentile_range(distribution_stats["ci_low"], distribution_stats["ci_high"]),
            "Approx. confidence interval across retained-model percentiles"
        )

    metric_boxes += make_metric_box("Evaluation ancestry match", f"{float(primary['target_ethnicity_share']):.0f}% {ethnicity}", "Primary model")
    metric_boxes += make_metric_box("Variant match", variant_match_value, variant_match_caption)
    metric_boxes += make_metric_box("Evaluation N", fmt_int(primary["evaluation_n"]), "Primary model")

    meta_rows = ""
    meta_rows = add_source_metadata(meta_rows, "Primary", primary)

    if odds_source is not None and str(odds_source.get("pgs_id")) != str(primary.get("pgs_id")):
        meta_rows = add_source_metadata(meta_rows, "Odds source", odds_source)

    if hazard_source is not None and str(hazard_source.get("pgs_id")) != str(primary.get("pgs_id")):
        meta_rows = add_source_metadata(meta_rows, "Hazard source", hazard_source)

    meta_rows += make_meta_row("Genome build", primary.get("original_genome_build", np.nan))
    meta_rows += make_meta_row("Variants", fmt_int(primary.get("number_of_variants", np.nan)))
    meta_rows += make_meta_row("Development method", primary.get("pgs_development_method", np.nan))
    meta_rows += make_meta_row("PGS release date", fmt_date(primary.get("pgs_release_date", np.nan)))
    meta_rows += make_meta_row("Performance ID", primary.get("ppm_id", np.nan))
    meta_rows += make_meta_row("Evaluation sample set ID", primary.get("pss_id", np.nan))
    meta_rows += make_meta_row("Publication ID", primary.get("pgp_id", np.nan))

    models_dropdown = make_models_dropdown(all_models)

    return f"""
    <article class="pgs-card">
      <div class="pgs-card-header">
        <div>
          <h3 class="pgs-title">{trait}</h3>
          <div class="pgs-subtitle">{html.escape(subtitle)}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="pgs-id-badge">{pgs_id}</div>
      </div>

      <div class="risk-badge risk-{risk_class}">{risk_label}</div>

      <div class="percentile-block">
        <div class="percentile-topline">
          <div class="percentile-label">{"Median percentile" if show_distribution_view else "Percentile"}</div>
          <div class="percentile-value">{fmt_percentile(display_percentile)}</div>
        </div>
        {percentile_bar}
        {consensus_box}
      </div>

      <div class="metric-grid">
        {metric_boxes}
      </div>

      <div class="metadata-panel">
        {models_dropdown}
        <details>
          <summary>Literature, validation metadata, and selected model sources</summary>
          <div class="meta-grid">
            {meta_rows}
          </div>
        </details>
      </div>
    </article>
    """

cards = "\n".join(make_trait_card(record) for record in sorted(card_records, key=lambda r: str(r["reported_trait"]).lower()))

html_out = f"""
<div class="pgs-card-grid">
  {cards}
</div>
"""

display(HTML(html_out))
```

## Methodological notes

```{=html}
<div class="method-note">
  <strong>Important limitations.</strong>
  Polygenic scores estimate inherited genetic predisposition; they are not diagnostic tests.
  AUROC, odds ratio, and hazard ratio values come from specific validation cohorts and may not transfer perfectly to every ancestry, age group, sex, genotyping array, or imputation pipeline.
  The individualized risk-effect calculation assumes that the source odds ratio or hazard ratio is reported per standard deviation of the PRS. If the original publication used a different effect unit or comparison group, the transformed percentage may be misleading and should be flagged in your score-selection database.
</div>
```
